notes.title: Crash issues
notes.notes:
When the app first comes in, we need to load the configuration file to make sure the app is working properly. However, this process can lead to a situation where the app crashes.
One possible cause is that there is an issue with the loading logic of the configuration file, such as an incorrect file path, an incorrect file format, or an abnormal configuration data. These issues can cause the application to behave unexpectedly when loading a configuration file, which can lead to a crash. On the second entry, the file will be automatically generated.
We are also actively working to resolve this issue, and we apologize for any inconvenience caused.

notes.title: A letter to the player
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45130732/89dc052f94f982ed1886a30d905b3c2ec53b40d9.png[/img]

First of all, thank you for purchasing and playing Crazy Islands. For our tiny team of five and sharks, your support is like a beacon in the midst of the raging waves, guiding us forward.
Founded in June 2024, GEAIVAN Game Studios is a small indie game team that has been passionate about creating a vibrant and adventurous game world for everyone. The journey of developing a game isn't easy, especially with a small team like ours. Due to limited resources, we had to put the game on the shelves while it was not yet complete. It's totally very tough for us, but it's to give more players an early taste of the unique fun of Crazy Islands and to provide feedback modifications that help us use a wider range of them. We promise that this interface is not a "work-in-progress" end, but a new starting point. In the coming days, we will continue to update your suggestions in depth and continue to improve the game. We've added islands with a wider plan, in-depth story exploration, and more thrilling survival challenges. We hope you'll overcome the shortcomings of the current version, and trust us – a small team of dreams and a driven shark will make Crazy Islands the magical world you want to be. Every support, every piece of feedback, or even just a place for us to stop by is what motivates us to keep going. Thank you again for choosing Crazy Islands. Our small team will do their best to live up to everyone's expectations.
Have a great adventure
GeAiVan Game Studios
